d:
Bharat ke khady suraksha aur manak pradhikran yani (FSSAI) ko bisleri ke pani ke ek sainpal men tay sima se jyada bromet mila. jab dobara janch huee to phir ismen polinyukliyar eromaitik haidrokarban (pieech) ka bhi pata chala. ab mamla itna aage barha ki 22 navanbar ko FSSAI ne kanpni ke khilaph mukadma chalane ki manjuri de di.
Halanki, bisleri kah rahi hai ki uska pani bilkul surakshit hai. lekin saval ye hai ki aakhir ye kemikal pani men pahunche kaise? inse hamari sehat ko kya khatra hai? ya iske pichhe koee aur vajah hai?
In sabhi savalon ke javab janne ke lie dekhie ye saransh.
